text:
tara: Quick sync 1: launching a gated-unlock PLG pilot tomorrow. Idea: staggered grant (50 immediate credits, extra 100 unlocked after attending a 20-min microwebinar or using 3 prompt templates). Hypothesis: unlocking by behavior increases prompt reuse and day7 retention vs flat grants. Need routing config + messaging variants.

evan: Love the behavioral unlock idea. It could cut cost while boosting engagement. Webinar short slot Tue 11am PT. I'll draft two subject lines and tiny landing copy.

kai: Cohort plan: randomized arms 1) flat 150 credits, 2) 50 credits + unlock path (webinar or 3 prompt uses). Target ~1k users per arm. We'll randomize at signup.

maya: Ops: check infra for microwebinar + recorded fallback. ops-bot, can you confirm we can host 150 concurrent and auto-fallback to recording embed for overflow? Also we need event webhooks to capture the "unlocked" action reliably.

ops-bot: Confirmed. Reserve capacity for 150 concurrent and pre-warm fallback recording. Webhook endpoints for unlock events: /webhooks/experiments/unlock-ready (auth via token). Runbook posted to #eng-infra.

kai: Routing pseudo (minimal):
```
segment: new_signups_0-3d
trigger: first_successful_call
actions:
  - assign_experiment: gated_unlock_v1
  - if arm == control:
      grant_credits: 150
  - if arm == treatment:
      grant_credits: 50
      create_unlock_path: [watch_microwebinar, use_3_prompts]
  - tag_event: experiment:gated_unlock_v1
metrics: d1_calls, unlock_rate, prompt_use_count, day7_retention
```
We must ensure events include experiment tag and unlock_reason.

tara: Messaging variants: A) "Start with 50 credits, unlock 100 more by joining a 20-min session" (transparency). B) "Get 50 credits + bonus when you try our ready prompts" (behavioral nudge). We'll A/B subject lines and hero CTA. Keep CTAs short: "Claim 50" vs "Claim + Unlock".

evan: Also propose an in-product coach bubble that nudges users towards the unlock path after first call: "Try 3 starter prompts to unlock 100 bonus credits." Short copy, one CTA.

nora: CS follow-up: for users who unlock via webinar, send a 2-email sequence with 3 example prompts tailored to their use-case plus a quick "how we built it" snippet to drive reuse. For prompt-based unlockers, send tips for composing prompts and a short leaderboard to encourage more use.

growth-bot: Baseline metrics pulled: day7 retention 18.0%, avg tokens/wk first 7 days 2.3k, est unit cost baseline $5.80. Uploaded CSV to #marketing-assets/gated_unlock_baseline.csv.

kai: Measurement plan: primary = day7 retention difference treatment vs control; secondary = unlock_rate, avg tokens/week, and cost-per-retained-user. Need a Console view: "gated_unlock_v1" with experiment filters. Can analytics create the view?

maya: I'll coordinate with analytics. Also add a realtime small signal check 48h after launch for unlock_rate and prompt use. If unlock_rate < 10% we might increase discoverability (in-app coach).

evan: Landing copy will feature an FAQ bullet: "How do I unlock?" and a small progress meter on the page for the "use 3 prompts" path. Also Loom recording embed for no-shows.

tara: Action items:
- @evan: landing + 3 subject lines + CTA variants (today EOD)
- @kai: implement experiment assigner and event tagging + webhook wiring (tomorrow AM)
- @maya: reserve infra + real-time signal runbook (today)
- @nora: CS sequences + prompt examples (tomorrow)
- @growth-bot: refresh baseline after seed and attach run CSVs

tara: Quick check on credit math: control = 150 upfront; treatment expected average burn lower because unlock sequence gates extra credits. If anyone has objections to amounts propose now.

evan: 50/100 feels reasonable. If unlock conversion is very high we can lower bonus in future runs.

kai: Agree. Keep amounts as is for first run to test behavioral effect.

nora: One small ask: tag users by unlock_reason (webinar vs prompt) so CS can tailor follow-ups.

growth-bot: Noted. Will include unlock_reason attribute in exported CSVs.

tara: OK launching tomorrow morning at 9am PT. I'll post a 1-pager with hypothesis and measurement plan in #marketing-assets and ping execs after 1-week readout. :white_check_mark:
